title_original: 군사법원서기ㆍ군검찰수사관 및 검찰서기의 전형에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 9 (Standards for Passing Selection Examination for Clerks)
(1) The distribution of marks for a selection examination for clerks shall be as follows:
1. Written examination: 100 points per subject;
2. Interview: 50 points.
(2) The maximum score for a selection examination for clerks shall be 550 points, being the combined score calculated according to paragraph (1).
(3) Persons who pass a selection examination for clerks shall satisfy all of the following requirements: Provided, That where the number of persons passing in an armed service (or, for civilian military employees of units or agencies directly under the Ministry of National Defense, the relevant unit or agency; hereinafter the same shall apply in this paragraph) exceeds the number of planned appointments for that armed service, the number of persons passing may be restricted by armed service in descending order of examination scores:
1. A total selection examination score of at least 330 points;
2. A score of at least 40 points in each subject of the written examination.
